integrity: A complete direct case proof and a standalone exact rational verification are provided. All numerical claims refer to this fixed finite setting; publication priority and independent validation have not been established.
scientific_limitations: Fixed field F_2, rank three, file dimensions (1,2), and four-to-five-column comparison. The hyperbolic retrieval conjecture is not refuted. No claim over larger fields, other sizes, or nonlinear codes.
title: A four-to-five-column obstruction to binary block-retrieval monotonicity
